scope: Canonical local/account/API stories; external providers stubbed and no paid action performed.

stories.evidence: Invalid registration rejected; normalized local registration established session; logout then wrong-password login rejected; correct login restored user.
POST /auth/logout removed user_email and clerk_id and /api/me returned authenticated=false.
Permanent Flask session remained authenticated across page reload and subsequent /api/me request.
Unauthenticated remote pin request rejected; authenticated add/list/delete lifecycle persisted in isolated local backing store.
Posting the same pre-login pin key twice created one remote record, which remained after page reload.
Missing model rejected; cached analysis returned with markdown and completed trace through POST and GET without a provider call.
All four searchable model controls and Save control exist; each model selection has matching localStorage save and load behavior in the browser script.
Empty candidates rejected; valid request forwarded selected model and instructions and parsed filtered TOON response. OpenRouter call was stubbed.
/api/me serialized authenticated Pro tier, status, period end, $8 limit, $2.25 used, and $5.75 remaining.
Invalid price rejected; valid subscribe and billing portal routes generated the expected Stripe parameters and returned URLs using an in-memory Stripe stub. No checkout was created.

warnings_detail.message: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated; use timezone-aware UTC datetimes.
warnings_detail.classification: Technical warning, not a failed user-story behavior.

boundaries: DASH-ANALYSIS-001 verified cache/error contracts without a paid OpenRouter generation.
DASH-FILTER-001 verified request/response behavior against a stubbed OpenRouter response.
DASH-UPG-002 verified checkout and portal request construction against an in-memory Stripe stub; no real Stripe session was created.
DASH-SET-001 is a deterministic DOM/source persistence contract check; full interaction rendering is left to the headless UI lane.
